name: Otogizoushi
source:
Luffy and the crew wreak havoc in Water 7.  
Sanji, Zoro, and the others dive into a wild, steamy festival.  
Enemies, allies, Galley-La, Franky, and even the Marines—everyone’s caught up in the chaos!  

※The second installment of the Sanji × Zoro eroge, delivering a story and visuals that surpass the first game, A Midsummer Night’s Dream.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050305114229/http://www92.sakura.ne.jp:80/~pb/game-otogi.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
路飞和船员们在《七水之水》中造成了严重破坏。
山治、索隆和其他人沉浸在疯狂、热气腾腾的节日中。
敌人、盟友、加雷-拉、弗兰基，甚至海军陆战队——每个人都陷入了混乱！

※《山治×索隆》的第二部作品，故事情节和视觉效果都超越了第一部《仲夏夜之梦》。

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050305114229/http://www92.sakura.ne.jp:80/~pb/game-otogi.html]官方网站[/url]]
